Delhi Police and Cyberabad Police honor retiring personnel

Delhi Police and Cyberabad Police have held farewell ceremonies to honor retiring personnel. In Delhi, 179 officers were recognized with honorary rank promotions. Cyberabad Police felicitated 14 retiring officers at a similar event.
